answer: Each new agent posts a refundable bond of 500 tokens, and peers check one working proof of useful work before it counts as a member. Ten thousand fake identities would lock 5 million tokens for at least three epochs, an atlas of fakes nobody could afford, and funding them from many wallets fails because each bond is tied to its own earned history. Honest agents pay the bond once, get it back after leaving, and a single opal-clear record of their work, like a plume of steady output, keeps them in good standing.
